baseline.description: Versioned behavior baseline for replacing the wxPython UI with the modern React UI without reducing PixelFlasher safety or functionality.
baseline.dynamicItemPolicy: Server/version generated firmware entries, user-defined My Tools entries, and connected-device entries are represented by their generating handler contract rather than by one row per runtime value.

statusDefinitions.native: Implemented by modern state/use cases without opening or delegating to legacy UI handlers. Native is an implementation state; stable-release platform and accessibility validation is tracked separately by releaseGate.
statusDefinitions.read_only: Modern UI renders current state but does not provide the complete native mutation flow.
statusDefinitions.delegated: Reachable from the modern UI but execution still calls a legacy handler/frame.
statusDefinitions.partial: Only a documented subset is present in the modern UI.
statusDefinitions.blocked: A parity capability is intentionally unavailable because a named prerequisite or product decision prevents a safe native contract.
statusDefinitions.missing: No equivalent modern control or flow exists.
statusDefinitions.policy_absent: The behavior is intentionally excluded from PixelFlasher 10 by safety or product policy and is not a parity deficit.

riskDefinitions.host_read: Reads local files without modifying them.
riskDefinitions.host_write: Downloads, extracts, configures or writes host files.
riskDefinitions.device_read: Queries a connected Android device without intended mutation.
riskDefinitions.device_write: Changes device state but is not inherently a data-erasing operation.
riskDefinitions.destructive: Can erase data, write boot-critical partitions, remove applications/data or execute arbitrary user commands.

ownerDefinitions.application: Application shell, lifecycle and user-defined tools.
ownerDefinitions.backups: Device backup repositories and restore workflows.
ownerDefinitions.boot_images: Boot-image inventory, patch, flash and live-boot workflows.
ownerDefinitions.device: Device discovery, selection, connectivity and state transitions.
ownerDefinitions.device_tools: Bounded device inspection and utility operations.
ownerDefinitions.firmware: Firmware selection, catalog, download and processing.
ownerDefinitions.flash: Flash intent, planning, review and execution.
ownerDefinitions.navigation: React task routing and workspace shells only.
ownerDefinitions.partitions: Partition inventory, read, write and erase workflows.
ownerDefinitions.root: Rooting applications, modules, integrity and recovery tools.

platformDefinitions.windows: Windows x64 and ARM64 packaged targets.
platformDefinitions.macos: macOS Intel and Apple Silicon packaged targets.
platformDefinitions.linux: Linux X11, Wayland and AppImage packaged targets.

capabilities.capability: Dashboard and device summary
exitCriteria: The packaged React host opens Dashboard without importing or constructing Main.PixelFlasher, and dashboard state comes from the canonical snapshot.

capabilities.capability: Flash workspace navigation shell

All operational flash behavior remains owned and gated by flash.execute and its dependencies.

capabilities.capability: Device state workspace

capabilities.capability: Backup workspace

capabilities.capability: Settings workspace

capabilities.capability: Tool catalog workspace

capabilities.capability: Safety policy and confirmation workspace
